name: Native NUN5 secondary font
description: Use NUN5's native 14x20 raster geometry and metrics for every same-semantic English glyph, reconstruct unsupported punctuation from clean NA2, and keep clean GF4C.
runtime_classification: Runtime-proven across matched Controls, Practice, Save/Load, and character-modal captures with complete printable-ASCII coverage; the user accepted this iteration while explicitly deferring its noticeably heavier weight for later refinement.
review_notes: Generated from hash-pinned clean NA2 and official NUN5 only. Fullwidth Shift-JIS Save/Load digits are not a Latin-weight parity target. The rejected m01, palette-swap, 10x22 resample, and global-parser approaches are not implementation parents.

name: Controls shrink-only auto-fit
description: Measure the first eight Controls labels with the native secondary-font metrics, shrink only strings wider than the 128-unit box, align all nine labels locally, and keep OFF on the ordinary renderer.
runtime_classification: Runtime-proven with the full official Ultimate Jutsu Prep label; Linked Attack remains full width, OFF stays on the ordinary renderer, and non-target screens remain outside the fit decision.
review_notes: Local port of NUN5's per-call decision and scale behavior; no global renderer redirect and no GF4C edit.

name: Character-modal alignment
description: Use independently measured local X positions for all five Back to Game Mode Screen modal rows while retaining their accepted local Y behavior.
runtime_classification: Runtime-proven against the matched native_final_v2 NA2 and NUN5 captures: ordinary row ink centers converge within 1 pixel and the long fifth row fits within the modal.
review_notes: Selected-shadow compensation preserves the same visible center; the tuning depends on the native glyph metrics.

name: Rejected 28x28 quad-height experiment
description: Historical clean-source experiment that changed the secondary renderer's second descriptor load from +0x0C to +0x10.
runtime_classification: Runtime rejected: clean NA2 descriptors made this a 28x28 quad, stretching both axes by 16.7 percent and damaging outline geometry without changing measurement.
review_notes: Retained disabled as exact negative evidence only; never select for normal builds.
